stories.title: S. Korea's Kim Min-young wins 1st kurash gold at Asian Games

en.title: S. Korea's Kim Min-young wins 1st kurash gold at Asian Games
en.summary: South Korean athlete Kim Min-young won gold in the women's +87-kilogram kurash event at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games, defeating a Chinese Taipei competitor. This marked South Korea's first Asian Games title in kurash since the sport was introduced to the Games in 2018.
